notes.title: DEMO RELEASE! The first website of the game is now avaliable!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! The demo for "HOMEPAGE" is now live!

With this demo you have full access to the first website of the game. You can also explore some of the features of the desktop! It's up to you to observe the "JEAM" website and find what changes over time and report the errors in order to stop the hacker attack!



Feedback on the demo of any kind is always appreciated! If you find any bugs, have any suggestions or just want to talk about what you think then we are glad to hear it!



And please be sure to wishlist the full game!
